name: Update Docs After Task
description: After each spec task completes: update the canonical tool catalog and any relevant instruction files to reflect what was implemented.
agentPrompt:
A spec task just completed. Update documentation:

1. Update `.claude/references/tool-catalog.md` — add, change, or remove any tool entries that reflect what was implemented in this task. If a command's behaviour changed, the catalog entry must change too.

2. If the task involved the FFP porting workflow, update `.claude/skills/dx9-ffp-port/SKILL.md` with any new findings (register layouts, pitfalls, game-specific notes).

3. If the task introduced a new game-specific macro file or patches folder, note the pattern in AGENTS.md if it is a repo-wide convention.
